faqs.question: What do Nihaara architects do?
faqs.answer: We are architects/designers who primarily offer services related to architectural design. We mainly design buildings, but we also deal with interiors, furniture, products, accessories, landscaping, as well as graphics if it is interesting.

faqs.question: Where is your office?
faqs.answer: Location: Vengalloor-kolany by-pass road, Thodupuzha, Idukki (D+), State: Kerala, Country: India

faqs.question: Do you have branches elsewhere?
faqs.answer: No

faqs.question: Since when have you been practicing?
faqs.answer: Since 2006, we founded Nihaara architects in the year 2006

faqs.question: What style of architecture do you practice?
faqs.answer: We are constantly searching for a language (style) of our own. As of now, our designs can be broadly categorized as contemporary, traditional & colonial.

faqs.question: Do you practice Traditional Kerala architecture?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many have asked us why we practice traditional architecture, being a practice based in Kerala.

faqs.question: Can we see any of your built works?
faqs.answer: We can guide you to our projects that are under construction. But regarding our finished projects, we prefer to respect the client’s privacy and let you access only the documentation of the project (photographs or videos of our project available on the internet).

faqs.question: Do we have to travel down to your office to meet you?
faqs.answer: Yes. That way you’d get to see how we work.

faqs.question: Do we need to take an appointment to meet you in your office?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have set aside the morning half of the office hours purely for designing, and it’s in the afternoon half of the office hours that we meet our clients to discuss project-related matters. Hence it is necessary to take an appointment in advance (by mail or phone) to meet us.

faqs.question: What time is the best to reach you on the phone?
faqs.answer: We prefer calls only on weekdays between 10.00 am to 6.00 pm. In case we were unable to pick your call during these hours, it may be because we were in a meeting. In such a situation kindly reach us afterward or leave a message.

faqs.question: When do we have the first meeting?
faqs.answer: If the client is comfortable with our ideas and working style, we give them an appointment for a meeting in our office. We usually meet the client in the afternoon session (between 3.00 pm to 6.00 pm) as the morning session is assigned for designing projects.

faqs.question: What should we bring when we come to meet you?
faqs.answer: It would be advisable to bring: a) copy of the village sketch of the site, b) detailed brief/requirements for the project, c) a few photographs or video clips of the site would be helpful too.

faqs.question: When would you start designing our project?
faqs.answer: We take up only a limited number of projects each year to maintain a certain level of quality, and as a result, we usually have a waiting list of projects/clients. We would add your project to this list and take it up based on the schedule.

faqs.question: How does the whole process of designing happen?
faqs.answer: When clients contact us for their project, we make sure that we send the link to this website or an email that contains a gist of this website’s content. If the clients are comfortable with our ideas of architecture/design mentioned in the details sent to them, we call them over for a meeting in our office after which we visit their site. After the site visit, we give them a list of points to be considered when they get the digital survey of the site done. Once the survey details are obtained, we call the clients for a detailed discussion and note down all details regarding the project. As the next step, we sit with these requirements and prepare a core concept which would give a direction to their project. Once a basic layout is ready, we call the clients for the next meeting, which would help us both finalize the design. If the clients have communicated well during the first two sessions, it has been our experience that the clients approve what we show them at this stage. As soon as the meeting is over, we strengthen our design based on the outcome of the discussion. The next step is to create detailed drawings for approval/construction.

faqs.question: Who would design our projects?
faqs.answer: It's sure that we are available at the office for all the major meetings as the design is developed together by us. Once we both feel that the project has reached a certain level of detail, we take all the responsibility for the project. However, the project would be designed by me and my team. Nihaara would be involved in every stage of it.

faqs.question: Do we have to pay you for the first site visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. We do charge a nominal fee (+actual travel fee) for our first site visit if the site is outside Thodupuzha city limits, as many inquiries that come our way need not materialize into full-fledged projects due to several reasons.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: (Please refer to our services and fee statements for details. If you don’t have it already, do contact us for the same.)

faqs.question: Do we have to pay you an advance before starting the project?
faqs.answer: Yes. The amount depends on the project. (Please refer to our services and fee statements for details. If you don’t have it already, do contact us for the same.)

faqs.question: When do we get the 'services and fee statement' from you?
faqs.answer: We usually send the 'services and fee statement' to the prospective clients only once we have had a detailed discussion (over the phone) regarding the project and choose to take it to the next level. It is necessary that we learn the project brief before we can send you the 'services and fee statement'. Do give us a call on the numbers given in the contact and request for the same.

faqs.question: If we are comfortable with each other’s ideas, what are the details required before designing our project?
faqs.answer: 1) Village Survey Sketch, 2) Total Station (Digital) Surveys in CAD/Dwg format. (We would give you instructions on points to be considered during the survey of your site), 3) Details of the site (we would give you a form which would have to be filled up by the client and returned to us), 4) A copy of the land deed document(s), 5) A copy of the Basic Tax Register (BTR from the village office) related to the survey number(s) of your site, 6) And, of course, detailed project requirements, 7) Nearest electric post number

faqs.question: Do you give us several options of designs to choose from?
faqs.answer: After finalizing your plan & 3D, we will draw all detailed drawings about your plan as per the 3D view. If you change the plan after finalization, additional charges may be applicable.

faqs.question: Do you take up construction of your designs?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: Do you supervise your projects?
faqs.answer: We do not offer regular supervision or bill checking as Nihaara Architects are a small studio that concentrates on design solutions rather than the execution of their projects for the time being. But, we do offer timely visits at various stages (depending on the scheme chosen) to ensure that the construction is as per the finalized design.

faqs.question: If we already have a plan ready from some other source, would you detail/design the rest of such a project?
faqs.answer: Yes, we will do!

faqs.question: Do you do elevations alone?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a teamwork.

faqs.question: Do you design considering Vasthu?
faqs.answer: Yes, we would like to consider the scientific vision of Vasthu.

faqs.question: What is NMD?
faqs.answer: NMD stands for Nihaara Micro Details.

faqs.question: What is Something Inside?
faqs.answer: Something Inside is the Interior division of Nihaara.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of NMD?
faqs.answer: This is our concept for more details of each and every room. It helps more for internal work and interior works. It has different stages. NMD is more helpful for all finishing works. It focused on 4 side elevations. (Please refer to our services and fee statements for details. If you don’t have it already, do contact us for the same).

faqs.question: How can we contact you?
faqs.answer: Write to us @ NIHAARA ARCHITECTS, Sreepadmam building, Vengalloor – kolany by-pass, Thodupuzha, Idukki (D+), Pin:-685608, Kerala, India, Call us @ +91 9447330144, +91 7559976144, +91 4862227515, Email us @ (Projects and other related enquiry only): vasthunihaara@gmail.com, (Internship related enquiry only): nihaaraarchitects@gmail.com, Follow us: Website - www.nihaara.com, Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/nihaaratdpa/, Instagram - https://instagram.com/nihaara_architects?igshid=t7xkh7usjl5d
